decisions.reason: As a further-developed and renamed version of an already well-liked trommel screen, it is tied to prior investment, existing customer acceptance, and a public commitment that management would be reluctant to reverse.

The mobile flail shredder line appears to be part of the firm's core mobile machinery range and was publicly refreshed for Stage V emissions, so sunk development and market signaling strongly favor continuation.

Although the evidence of market traction is weaker than for the other surviving launches, it gained a dedicated presentation by 2019 and remains strategically aligned with the firm's recycling and mobile processing focus, which supports keeping it.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder was heavily and confidently positioned as a new generation setting standards, indicating high commitment and making withdrawal especially unlikely absent clear failure evidence.
